beats.text: Five characters so vivid they feel like people you've actually met.
One. Elizabeth Bennet — Austen's sharp, proud, utterly modern heroine.
Two. Captain Ahab — Melville's monument to obsession, chasing a whale into the abyss.
Three. Heathcliff — Brontë's dark, doomed storm of a man you can't look away from.
Four. Jay Gatsby — Fitzgerald's dreamer, reinventing himself for a love already gone.
Five. Raskolnikov — Dostoevsky's tormented student, unravelling under his own guilt.
Great characters outlive their books, and their authors. Full retellings of each are on the channel.
